areas.title: Session engine: keep going until done, recover from crashes and stops, tell specialists enough, report the result briefly
problems: [blocker] After a hard crash or forced close mid-session the agent can never start a session again. Every Start returns 409 'agent Alice already has an active session <uuid>'. Stop, Stop all + Resume and a clean restart do not clear it, while the ghost session shows 'running / live' for ever. Evidence: /tmp/frbench/walk-chain-and-failure/steps/87,88,91,93,97-*.png; /tmp/frbench/walk-lifecycle/steps/28,31,33,34-*.png; problems.jsonl 409 POST /sessions

[major] A session runs only the tasks that were ready when it started. A 7-task chain took 7 Starts, 5 tasks took 3, and 6 done tasks took 8. Each session ended 'completed' while the next task was already unblocked. Evidence: /tmp/frbench/smoke/steps/14,16,24-*.png; /tmp/frbench/walk-first-project/steps/25-37; /tmp/frbench/walk-chain-and-failure/steps/13,15,35-*.png and notes.jsonl {starts:7}; /tmp/frbench/walk-tasks-tab/steps/16-tasks-tab-after-refresh.png

[major] Critic send-backs and retries wait for the next manual Start. It took 4 Starts, each 'completed' in green, to reach the sign-off card. Evidence: /tmp/frbench/walk-needs-me/steps/36-41; /tmp/frbench/walk-chain-and-failure/steps/51,58,68-*.png; /tmp/frbench/walk-words-and-structure/steps/38,43-*.txt

[major] The monthly critic calibration runs as the person's agent. On the 1st of the month it blocks Start with the same 409 and makes about 160 critic calls (up to USD 10 with a real key). It also runs, and fails, on an install with no key. Evidence: /tmp/frbench/smoke/steps/20-session-2-did-not-open.png; /tmp/frbench/smoke/steps/problems.jsonl; /tmp/frbench/walk-lifecycle daemon.log 'calibration failed … no model for tier sonnet on provider none'

[major] The approved first-session plan and the queued notes (the 'Project brief' note included) are used up when a session starts. They are lost if the session is stopped after 7 s, if it plans nothing, or if Start is pressed before the plan is approved. After that no specialist ever sees the person's brief, and a 'task' item in the queue never becomes a task. Evidence: /tmp/frbench/walk-first-project/steps/79,80-*.png, 76-78; /tmp/frbench/walk-lifecycle/steps/03,16-*.png

[major] A failed run's reason is the model's first remark ('I'll look at what is already in the folder first.'). 'model call failed' appears only in daemon.log. Evidence: /tmp/frbench/inject/steps/01-failed-task-and-docker-wait-on-the-tasks-tab.png; /tmp/frbench/walk-chain-and-failure/steps/124-c-s3-tasks-tab.png; /tmp/frbench/walk-needs-me/steps/64,65

[major] Specialists get no project goal or brief. The words 'greeting' and 'date' appear in no brief after the first one. They get no word about the step before ('builds on the step before' without naming it), no report or error from the previous attempt, and none of the person's move reasons (0 matches in the model-call log). A retry after an error says 'the critic's findings below', and no findings follow. Judged from the model-call log. Evidence: /tmp/frbench/walk-first-project/home/bench/model-calls.jsonl seq 162,167,174,180,187; /tmp/frbench/walk-tasks-tab/home/bench/model-calls.jsonl; /tmp/frbench/walk-chain-and-failure/home/bench/model-calls.jsonl seq 18,219

[major] The end-of-session summary is a 100-word paragraph. It starts with a waiting list captured before the work ran, so tasks that were just done or just failed read '(ready)', and it ends with six zero counts. The 'Left out for budget' line is in USD. The same paragraph is copied to the session page, the Overview, an Inbox message and the notification. Evidence: /tmp/frbench/walk-words-and-structure/steps/19,23,83-*; /tmp/frbench/walk-chain-and-failure/steps/15,123-*; /tmp/frbench/walk-lifecycle/steps/49-*.txt; /tmp/frbench/walk-needs-me/steps/77-78 (31 unread messages)

[major] Nothing moves while a task runs: 'Steps 0 / 200', 'CHF 0.00' and no log line for the whole run. No session events exist between task.started and task.files. Evidence: /tmp/frbench/walk-lifecycle/steps/11,22-*.png; /tmp/frbench/walk-first-project/steps/58-change-session-t-9s.png; /tmp/frbench/walk-chain-and-failure/steps/82-b-recovery-s1-live.png

[major] Stop kills the task at once, with error styling, and calls it 'killed' / 'Kill switch: one session stopped'. Quit leaves the task with the reason 'kill switch'. The session page has no 'stop after this task'. Evidence: /tmp/frbench/walk-lifecycle/steps/12,13,27-*.png; /tmp/frbench/walk-chain-and-failure/steps/104,105-*.png

[major] The Start dialog says only what will NOT run. Start stays enabled when nothing can run, which makes empty 'completed' sessions graded 100 that use up the queue. The default budget is hidden; -5 and 0 are silently replaced and 1000000 is accepted. The kill switch and a missing key show only after pressing Start. The typed Reason is thrown away. Evidence: /tmp/frbench/walk-lifecycle/steps/04,07,08,19,49,72-*; /tmp/frbench/walk-chain-and-failure/steps/71,101,126-*.png; /tmp/frbench/walk-first-project/steps/16-start-session-dialog-before-approving.png

[major] The project stage stays 'planning' and milestones never close. The project never says it is finished. docs/status.md says 'Blocked: nothing' while the whole chain is blocked, and Chat reads it. Evidence: /tmp/frbench/walk-first-project/steps/alldone-Plan-vp.png, 66-home-at-the-end.png; /tmp/frbench/walk-chain-and-failure/home/data/projects/01a196f8-1b65-75e6-bc6e-3cec2e81d6d4/workspace/docs/status.md
[minor] The retry ladder hands a CSS task to writer-marketing while the log says 'designer'. Evidence: /tmp/frbench/walk-words-and-structure/steps/38,43-*.txt; model-calls.jsonl seq 185-194
[minor] A queued start says in the same dialog that it 'would plan nothing'. Evidence: /tmp/frbench/walk-chain-and-failure/steps/101-q-second-while-first-runs-after-start.png
root_causes: Fixed plan (verified): runner.ts:807 reads store.task.readyTasks once. StaticPlanner (runner.ts:2646-2676) plans only tasks whose dependencies are all done at that moment (packages/state/src/repos/task.ts:264-273). runner.ts:981 then loops over the fixed plan.items. Tasks unblocked during the session are never seen.
Retries leave the session (verified): runner.ts:1394-1396 only does retried.push(task.id) for a revise or retry verdict. The critic follow-up puts the task back to ready for a later session.

Orphan sessions (verified): runner.ts:505-513 refuses a start while store.session.active(agent.id) returns a row, and session.ts:117 returns every running or paused row whether or not a process is behind it. At daemon start, compose.ts:3386-3391 closes only intake sessions (intake.closeExpired, intake.ts:544). POST /sessions/:id/stop (server.ts:1241-1245) only calls kill.stop, and KillSwitch.stop (killswitch.ts:111-160) aborts in-memory registrations and never writes the session or run row.

Calibration holds the principal (verified): jobs/calibration.ts:263-264 inserts a status 'running' session with agent_id = deps.agentId, and compose.ts:2679 passes agentId: agent.id (the principal). triggers.ts:310-333 fires a monthly schedule seen for the first time on its due day as soon as its time has passed. The job is scheduled whatever the provider.
Queue consumed too early (verified): runner.ts:769 runs consumeQueue() during the brief, before planning. runner.ts:979 calls markFirstSessionRun() before any task runs, whatever the outcome.

Failure reason (verified): executor.ts:1018-1020 sets summary = finalText.slice(0,2000) || error || outcome, so any text the model wrote before the error wins. runner.ts:1427-1436 then stores result.summary.slice(0,200) as the failed reason.

Thin brief (verified): executor.ts:552-575 builds goal = `${title}: ${outcome}`, contextLinks = [task:<id>, pr, branch] and fixed constraints. It has no project goal or brief, no results of the tasks it depends on, no previous report or error and no task.reason. retryConstraints (executor.ts:319-341) writes the 'findings below' rung line for every attempt >= 1, whether or not findings exist. renderBrief is brief.ts:47.

Stale summary (verified): runner.ts:833 computes `waiting` at plan time, and the same list is passed to summarize() at the end (runner.ts:1533-1555). summarize() (runner.ts:2397-2470) joins about 15 templates with countsSentence last. summarizeLeftOut (runner.ts:2473-2486) formats amounts with '$'.
next_steps (verified): runner.ts:1767 writes summary_cache.next_steps = skipped.slice(0,3), which is empty whenever the plan ran. views.ts and agent.ts:980 both read it.

Frozen progress: runner.ts:1808-1813 writes steps and spent_usd_micro only at the end, and SessionRepo.recordSpend (session.ts:106, verified) is never called per step. The specialist's model and tool steps are not kept as session events (U-086).

Stop reasons: /shutdown (server.ts:1279, verified) calls kill.stop('all','Forerunner quit'). The claim release writes 'kill switch' for every stop (compose.ts:1542-1547; unconfirmed, from the lifecycle walk). Pause exists only in the command registry (wiring/session-ports.ts:53-85; unconfirmed).

Start dialog (verified): StartSessionDialog.tsx:280-287 disables Start only on busy || !identity. nothingRuns (:144) is not used for it. Budgets <= 0 become undefined (:122-126). NotInThisSession (:66-97) lists only what will not run. The reason is not passed to runner.start (compose.ts:2771-2781; unconfirmed, from the lifecycle walk).

Stage and milestones (verified): create-project.ts:45 sets stage 'planning', and no runtime code writes the stage again. No runtime code moves a milestone to done; only the person's edit route (server.ts:940) changes milestones.

Specialist hand-over (verified): executor.ts:456-476 swaps the specialist after task.started was emitted with the planned one. The alternate ranking in registry/alternates.ts was not read (unconfirmed).
areas.fix_scope:
1. Replace the fixed loop with re-planning. After every task and every critic verdict, re-read readyTasks and the sandbox gate. Take the newly unblocked tasks, the sent-back tasks (next rung, same session, within the ladder) and the tasks the person made ready, in first-session order and then by priority. Stop only on: nothing runnable, budget used (keep the reserve), stop by the person, or wall clock. Record one named stop reason.
2. Startup recovery in compose.ts, before triggers start: end every running or paused work session of this install's agents that has no live runner (status stopped, stop_reason 'interrupted'). End running run rows, release claims, put claimed and in_progress tasks back to ready with the reason 'Forerunner closed while it ran', and post one Update. Make /sessions/:id/stop end a row that has no live registration. Never show the raw claim_conflict text.
3. Calibration runs as the critic agent (or a system agent), never holds the principal, is skipped without a working provider, and does not fire on the day an install first sees its schedule.
4. Use queue items and the first-session plan only when the run they were given to finishes (done or in review). Return them after a killed, stopped, failed or empty session. A 'task' queue item becomes a ready task when it is queued.
5. A failed run's reason is the error in words (result.error first for errored runs). A transient error is retried once at once.
6. Brief: a fixed 'Project' section (goal, the person's brief from summary_cache.brief, pointers to docs/overview.md and the decision record). 'Done before this task': each dependency's title, changed files and one-line result. On a retry, the previous attempt's report or error. The person's latest note on the task and the session note. Answers given, or 'the person chose to go ahead without answering'. The 'findings below' line only when findings follow.
7. Rewrite summarize() to design §5: at most 3 lines, task names, the state at the end (recompute waiting), CHF, no zero counts. Write a structured last_session.outcome {done[], failed[{title,reason}], needsYou[], leftOver[]} for Overview and Chat. Stop writing next_steps = skipped. The session-end Inbox message becomes one line with a link.
8. Live progress: recordSpend per model call, and a short persisted task.step session event per tool call (feeds U-086).
9. Stops: POST /sessions/:id/pause ('Stop after this task'); POST /sessions/:id/stop is 'Stop now' with reason 'you'. Carry the reason (you / Stop all / quit / interrupted) into session.ended, the task reason and the notification. A person's stop is not an error event.
10. Start dialog and start-check: say what will run ('runs X, then continues with N more'). Prefill the real default budget. Refuse a budget <= 0 or above what is left this month. Disable Start, with the reason and the unblocking button, when nothing can run, sessions are stopped or there is no provider. Keep the person on the page after Start. Queued wording. The Reason field becomes 'Note for this session' and reaches every brief (thread it through compose runSession into SessionStartOptions).
11. Close a milestone when all its tasks are done and advance the stage. Fill docs/status.md 'Blocked' from waitingTasks and the sandbox wait.
12. Emit task.started after the specialist is chosen. Pick an alternate by task kind (U-044); this may be deferred.
areas.acceptance:
Fresh bench (--provider bench, --fresh, a date on the 1st of the month or the calibration schedule forced due).
(a) With FORERUNNER_BENCH_PLAN=chain, approve the 7-task plan and press Start ONCE. All 7 tasks run in that one session. The session result has at most 3 lines, names what was done with CHF, and has no '(ready)' list. No 409 at any point, including while the calibration runs.
(b) With CRITIC_REJECT on one task, the rework is accepted in the same session.
(c) With FAIL='Step 3' (report mode), the retries all run in one session, then exactly one Inbox card appears. Steps 4-7 are not attempted. The result says that Step 3 needs your decision.
(d) With FAIL_MODE=error, the task row reads 'Failed: …model call failed…', not the model's first remark.
(e) Run restart-daemon.mjs --hard while a task runs. After reconnecting, the old session reads 'Interrupted', the task is Ready, one Update is posted, and the next Start works the first time.
(f) With DELAY_MS=3000, the session page's steps and spend move during a task; the DB has task.step events mid-task. 'Stop after this task' finishes the current task and then ends. 'Stop now' puts the task back to Ready with 'Stopped by you' and no error line.
(g) In the model-call log, every specialist brief carries the project goal and the brief's words ('greeting', 'date' for the first-project brief). Each chain step names the previous step's title and file. A retry after an error carries the error. A reason typed in Mark ready / Try again appears in the next brief.
(h) Start is disabled before the plan is approved and when nothing can run. After approval, the first specialist still gets the brief.
(i) When every task is done, the milestone is done and the project status reads Done.

areas.title: Tasks screen: plain per-state actions, live rows, a task drawer with editing, Reopen and Redo, links that open
problems: [major] Clicking PR does nothing in the desktop window, because it is a raw <a target=_blank>. The same bug is in SandboxSettingsCard.tsx:165, UpdatesPage.tsx:400 and PeersSection.tsx:77. Evidence: /tmp/frbench/walk-tasks-tab/steps/35-tasks-tab-with-pr-link.png; /tmp/frbench/walk-tasks-tab/scripts/10-pr.cjs

[major] The move buttons are the raw state graph: 'Needs me / Mark failed / Cancel / Depends on…', 'Send to review', 'Mark done'. The dialog's whole explanation is 'ready → needs_human', and badges and filters show raw states. Evidence: /tmp/frbench/walk-tasks-tab/steps/11,21,41,49-*.png; /tmp/frbench/smoke/steps/13-tasks-after-approval.png

[major] 'Send to review' on a running task throws its work away and leaves it in review for ever. The only way out is 'Mark done', which closes work that was never built. Evidence: /tmp/frbench/walk-tasks-tab/steps/48,49,50-*.png, 51-changes-page-from-in-changes.txt

[major] 'Needs me' parks a task silently: there is no card and the reason never reaches the agent, yet the project then says 'needs you'. Evidence: /tmp/frbench/walk-tasks-tab/steps/19,20-*.png; /tmp/frbench/walk-chain-and-failure/steps/136-139; /tmp/frbench/walk-needs-me/steps/50-b-needs-me-dialog.png

[major] The Tasks tab never updates by itself while a session runs: rows say 'ready' while the task is in_progress. Evidence: /tmp/frbench/walk-tasks-tab/steps/40-mark-failed-screen-before-refresh.png; /tmp/frbench/walk-first-project/steps/59-tasks-tab-during-change-t-9s.png

[major] A task cannot be opened or edited. The outcome and criteria are never shown, and a tier-2 task can only be recreated. Evidence: /tmp/frbench/walk-tasks-tab/steps/36,54-*.png; /tmp/frbench/walk-first-project/steps/46-after-clicking-a-done-task-title.png
[major] A cancelled task cannot be reopened and a done task cannot be redone. Evidence: /tmp/frbench/walk-tasks-tab/steps/24,25,49-*.png

[major] Mark ready on a task that waits for answers runs it without them. Its question card stays open and blocking, and a later answer does nothing. Evidence: /tmp/frbench/walk-tasks-tab/steps/47,53-*.png; /tmp/frbench/walk-needs-me/steps/68,69,70-*.png

[major] New task offers 'full review (tier 2/3)' with no word that it needs Docker, and the task then waits for ever. Tasks that wait for a dependency or for Docker show 'ready', and dependency labels say '(ready)'. Evidence: /tmp/frbench/walk-tasks-tab/steps/06,12-*.png; /tmp/frbench/walk-chain-and-failure/steps/07-a-tasks-after-approval.png, 158-d-tasks-with-docker-wait.png

[minor] Undo is offered for some moves and not others, 'Undo.' appears twice, and dependency edits are not in the change log. Evidence: /tmp/frbench/walk-tasks-tab/steps/20-needs-me-on-ready-after.png, 51-changes-page-from-in-changes.txt

[minor] New task has no specialist field, so every hand-made task runs as coder. Chat's task_create tool makes a DRAFT task. Evidence: /tmp/frbench/walk-tasks-tab/steps/10,49-*.png; /tmp/frbench/walk-first-project/steps/chat-tool-task-create-vp.png, 64-start-dialog-with-only-a-draft-task.png

[minor] Row lines show raw ids and machine reasons ('claimed by 01a196d2-…', 'request 01a196fe-…', 'retry ladder exhausted … (ceiling opus)'). A stale-row move shows the version error twice with no reload. The dependency picker silently accepts a failed task. Evidence: /tmp/frbench/walk-tasks-tab/steps/33,49,54-*.png; /tmp/frbench/walk-words-and-structure/steps/75-tasks-after-accept-on-ladder-card.txt

[polish] The cap text stays on finished rows, '1,50' is refused, rows jump on reload, and the search offers ids nobody can see. Evidence: /tmp/frbench/walk-tasks-tab/steps/09-new-task-budget-with-comma.png, 11 vs 16
root_causes: Links (verified): TasksTab.tsx:332-340 renders a raw <a target="_blank"> instead of ExternalLink (components/ExternalLink.tsx:9-29 drops target in the shell). windows.rs:102 handles only on_navigation, and there is no new-window handler. grep finds the same at SandboxSettingsCard.tsx:165, UpdatesPage.tsx:400 and PeersSection.tsx:77. Tauri's default for an unhandled new-window request was not observed (unconfirmed).

Buttons = graph (verified): lib/task-transitions.ts:6-16 mirrors TASK_TRANSITIONS. humanTransitions (:33) turns every non-agent edge into a button with TRANSITION_LABELS (:39-48), and done/cancelled have none. TasksTab.tsx:358-368 renders them, and :307 shows t.status raw.

Transition route (verified): server.ts:961-1003 executes task.transition, then rt.kill.stopTask. It never closes the task's open requests. in_review is never planned again, because sessions plan only readyTasks.

No live data (verified): TasksTab.tsx:108-115 loads tasks and runs once with useAsync and never subscribes. ProjectPage.tsx:56 prefers its own one-off fetch (`project.data ?? cached`), and context.tsx:117-121 only upserts the store on project.changed.

No edit or reopen (verified): server.ts has only POST /tasks/:id/transition (:961) and /tasks/:id/dependencies (:1007), which bypasses the commands and the change log. commands/task.ts has create and transition only. TaskRepo.reopen exists (state repos/task.ts:238) but only Undo calls it.

Command defaults and sentences (verified): commands/task.ts:35 defaults status to 'draft'. transitionSentence (:151-152) uses raw states and appends ' Undo.'. CreateTaskBody has no specialist (api-types.ts:638-650; unconfirmed line). NewTaskDialog lists tiers 0-3 with no sandbox status.
areas.fix_scope:
1. Replace task-transitions.ts with the per-status action table of design §3.5: Make ready, Edit, Change what it waits for, Pause, Resume, Stop, Try again, Answer, Redo, Reopen, Cancel. Remove Mark failed, Send to review, Mark done and Needs me from the person's buttons. Each dialog shows one consequence line and an optional 'Note for the agent'. Cancel names the tasks that wait on it.
2. The daemon computes `display` {label, tone, blocker:{kind,title,requestId}} in taskView (views.ts) from status, dependencies, the sandbox state and open requests. This one map feeds the badge, the filter, the Start dialog and Chat. claimedBy becomes the agent's name. The cap line shows only on open tasks.
3. Commands in packages/commands/src/commands/task.ts: task.update (wording, criteria, priority, budget, review level, specialist; logged, undoable); task.reopen (cancelled to ready; done to ready with a note); task.dependencies (replaces the direct route; logged, undoable, read back in Chat). Pause = ready to needs_human with the marker 'paused by you'; Resume = back to ready. task.create defaults to ready. Sentences drop ' Undo.'. Every person move can be undone by restoring the previous status.
4. Routes: PATCH /tasks/:id and POST /tasks/:id/reopen; dependencies go through the command. A person's move closes the task's open question or sign-off cards with 'withdrawn: you moved the task' and records 'go ahead without answers' for the brief.
5. A new TaskDrawer: outcome, criteria, what it waits for, runs (specialist, report, error; steps once the engine keeps them), changed files, the review in plain words, the PR, Edit.
6. NewTaskDialog: review level with Docker status ('Full review: needs Docker, not running on this computer'); 'Who does it' (let the agent choose / a specialist / 'Me: ask me in the Inbox', which sets specialist 'person' for needs-me); Low/Medium/High priority; a decimal comma is accepted.
7. Live: reload on project.changed and session events. Show rows in run order and keep filters in the URL.
8. Links: an inline ExternalLink variant used at all four target=_blank sites. An on_new_window handler in windows.rs opens http(s) links in the system browser. A test fails on any target="_blank" outside ExternalLink in the desktop UI.
areas.acceptance:
Bench walk-tasks-tab journey (fresh home, a project with no brief, five tasks made with New task, one at 'Full review').
(a) The dialog says that Full review needs Docker, which is not running.
(b) Rows read 'Waiting for "Write a README…"' and 'Waiting for Docker'. No visible text matches needs_human|in_progress|claimed by|request 01|ready → .
(c) Clicking a title opens the drawer with the outcome and criteria. Edit lowers the Docker task's review level, and the next session runs it.
(d) Start a session and stay on Tasks: rows go Running, then Done, without Refresh.
(e) Pause makes a task 'Paused by you', creates no Inbox card and does not make the project 'needs you'. Resume makes it Ready.
(f) Stop on a running task stops only that run.
(g) Cancel on a task with a dependant names the dependant. Reopen brings the cancelled task back as Ready. Redo with a note on a done task reopens it, and the note is in the next brief (model-call log, after the session-engine merge).
(h) Mark ready on a task with open questions withdraws its card with a line.
(i) Undo after every action restores the previous state.
(j) With pr_url set in the DB and the shell config injected, the PR link has no target attribute and opens through the shell's navigation. The cargo test for the new-window handler passes, and the unit test forbids target="_blank".
(k) A stand-in chat tool call task_create makes a READY task.

shared_files: packages/runtime/src/daemon/server.ts: owned by session-engine (POST /sessions, /sessions/:id/stop|pause, /shutdown, /kill, /projects/:id/start-check). tasks-screen edits only the /tasks/* handlers, needs-me only /inbox, /requests/:id/answer and /projects/:id/intake/*, and chat only adds the conversation routes. progress-navigation puts its files routes in docs-routes.ts, not here.

packages/runtime/src/daemon/views.ts: owned by system-text (session event lines, costView). tasks-screen edits only taskView (wave 1), needs-me only requestView (wave 2), progress-navigation only projectView and the project card (wave 3, alongside system-text, in different functions).
packages/runtime/src/daemon/api-types.ts: owned by session-engine. Every other area only adds fields to its own view and body types.

apps/ui/src/api/client.ts, apps/ui/test/fake-daemon.ts, apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts: owned by tasks-screen. AGENTS.md requires every route change to update all three in the same commit, so each later area appends its own route cases. The mobile screens share client.ts and must keep compiling.
packages/runtime/src/session/runner.ts: owned by session-engine. needs-me may add only the failed-task card call, after session-engine is merged.

packages/runtime/src/daemon/compose.ts: owned by session-engine (startup recovery, calibration wiring, the session-start reason). chat wires its read-tool ports in loop/commands.ts instead. progress-navigation only exports the existing projectWorkspaceDir.

packages/commands/src/commands/task.ts and packages/commands/src/commands/index.ts: owned by tasks-screen (task.update, task.reopen, task.dependencies, pause/resume, ready default). chat adds only the registration lines for commands/read.ts and session.resume.
packages/state/src/repos/task.ts: owned by tasks-screen (reopen from done). session-engine only uses the readiness helpers.

apps/ui/src/pages/project/PeersSection.tsx, apps/ui/src/pages/SandboxSettingsCard.tsx, apps/ui/src/pages/UpdatesPage.tsx: tasks-screen changes only the target=_blank link line. PeersSection is otherwise owned by progress-navigation.
apps/ui/src/pages/ProjectPage.tsx: owned by progress-navigation (including the `cached ?? project.data` fix); tasks-screen does not touch it.
apps/ui/src/pages/project/SummaryTab.tsx: owned by progress-navigation. The DecisionsSection.tsx it embeds is owned by system-text.
docs/user-guide.md: owned by progress-navigation (structure). Each area edits only its own section (sessions, tasks, Inbox, Chat).
